name: web-black-agency-page-with-four-colour-service-cards
title: Black Agency Page with Four Colour Service Cards
whatItIs: A black rounded page with a nav, a big white headline 'Marketing is an art and we're artists', four short blurbs with underlined links and four tall service cards in pink, lime, orange and cream with black glyph icons and numbered titles, the lime one expanded with a description.
whatItMeans: Bright cards on black feel bold and creative, and a single expanded card shows interaction.
techniques: Four saturated cards on a black ground
Simple black glyph icons in each card
One card expanded to show hover state

vocabulary.definition: A card describing one offered service.
The look of an element when the pointer is over it.
A simple abstract symbol used as an icon.
